comment: The exact Rust Chip (chip-rs) that this repository's Rust Chip workload was tested against. Rust Chip and Rust FX are versioned independently of Compute and of each other; they are recorded, not synchronised. Not the npm Chip/Eve agent or the npm FX/Zig.
release_tag_status: not yet created: the build session was refused tag pushes (HTTP 403). The workflow .github/workflows/release.yml in chip-rs publishes the artifact when that tag is pushed; until then this pin is by commit, which is equally exact.
tested_by: cargo test -p compute-rust-chip --locked (10 tests: provider contract, concurrent conflicting edits in two Compute sessions, git isolation, failure and cleanup-failure isolation, local-vs-Compute equivalence), against a real Compute target, real Git, real PAX and real Cargo; the model is a scripted stand-in
